mcp.name: GitHub
mcp.description: Repositories, issues, and pull requests via the GitHub MCP server.

credential.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
credential.help: Create at https://github.com/settings/tokens with the scopes you need.

mcp.name: Filesystem
mcp.description: Read and write files in a local directory.

mcp.name: GBrain (memory)
mcp.description: Persistent, queryable memory — search/think over a local gbrain (by Garry Tan). Requires gbrain installed.

server.description: GBrain memory MCP server (local). Install once: `bun install -g github:garrytan/gbrain`, then `gbrain init`.

mcp.name: GBrain (remote)
mcp.description: Connect to a hosted gbrain over HTTP with a bearer token.

credential.label: GBrain access token
credential.help: From your gbrain server: gbrain connect <url> --token <tok>.

channels.name: Telegram
channels.description: Reach the agent through a Telegram bot.

credential.label: Telegram Bot Token
credential.help: Create a bot with @BotFather and copy its token.

channels.name: Slack
channels.description: Talk to the agent from a Slack workspace.

credential.label: Slack Bot Token
credential.help: Create a Slack app, add a bot user, and install it to your workspace.

channels.name: Discord
channels.description: Run the agent as a Discord bot.

credential.label: Discord Bot Token
credential.help: Create an application in the Discord developer portal and add a bot.

channels.name: WhatsApp
channels.description: Reach the agent on WhatsApp via the WhatsApp Business Cloud API.

credential.label: WhatsApp Business Token
credential.help: From Meta → WhatsApp (Business Cloud API): a permanent access token. Also set the channel config phone_number_id.

credential.label: Twilio Auth Token
credential.help: From the Twilio console. Also set the channel config account_sid and from_number.

channels.name: Email
channels.description: Reach the agent over email via an email provider API.

credential.label: Email API Key
credential.help: An API key from your email provider (e.g. Postmark, Resend, or SendGrid).

channels.name: Webhook
channels.description: Receive events through an inbound HTTP webhook.

credential.label: Webhook Signing Secret
credential.help: Optional shared secret used to verify inbound webhook signatures.
